## Head-to-head (row system's side, both seatings)

J = player-aware judge (model-judged, primary). CONS = population consensus (model-judged). Personal part = judge's personal-sum difference (pp of team skill sum). J corrected = attenuation-corrected J (personal part divided by lambda = 0.419; a model-based sensitivity).

J_cal = J with the two parts calibrated on held-out judge-window games (1.17 logit p_cons + 1.00 personal term; a sensitivity check).

## WP-seed rescoring and behavior (all tournament drafts of each system)

Opponent sets differ by system, so compare spread and LCB gap, not levels. GD similarity: share of the system's picks equal to GD's argmax at that state.
